mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_play_history (user_id, video_id, file_index, last_update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{videoId}, #{fileIndex}, #{lastUpdateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_index = #{fileIndex}, last_update_time = #{lastUpdateTime}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM video_play_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND video_id = #{videoId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM video_play_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND video_id = #{videoId}
